Absolutely appalling behaviour from the doctors and staff.
My father rang simply to enquire about his medication — a basic, reasonable question that any patient should be able to ask. During the call, staff clearly believed he had hung up, and proceeded to speak about him in a disgusting and unprofessional manner, including calling him an “arsehole” and making other derogatory remarks.
This wasn’t a misunderstanding or a poor bedside manner — it was outright disrespect. Hearing medical professionals speak about a patient like that is shocking and completely unacceptable. It raises serious concerns about how patients are treated when they’re not “on the line.”
Healthcare staff are meant to show compassion, professionalism, and basic human decency. What we experienced was the exact opposite. No apology, no accountability — just behaviour that would be unacceptable in any workplace, let alone a medical setting.
